sections.title: Water Supply
sections.text: NAC (Notified area council) water supply is available. Apart from Municipal water supply, LH has I HP Jet pump motor (Texmo make) use to pump water from bore well to overhead RCC tank placed beside pump house and 1 HP mono block pump motor (Texmo make) use for gardening purpose. Jet pump were purchased on 04.10.2016 and Mono block pump were purchased on 16.05.2017.

sections.text: In the printed postal address the dashes after "PO" and "Gopalpur" are overstruck (strikethrough) through the adjacent letters.

sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all-weather road. The nearest Railway Station is Brahmapur which is approx. 15 Km from Gopalpur Lighthouse.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text: Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and Kendriya Vidyalaya all are within 5 KM from Gopalpur Lighthouse.
